findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler can no longer be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but its body is just `pass`, so it does not implement the inherited abstract members `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, or the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. StatefulDetectorHandler remains abstract, therefore `group_type.detector_handler(self)` in Detector.detector_handler raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler` instead of returning a handler. Previously this handler implemented `evaluate()` returning `[]` and could be instantiated as a no-op. Any detector of type `metric_alert_fire` processed through `process_detectors` will now crash detector processing (the TypeError is not caught by the `detector_handler` property or `process_detectors`). Either implement the abstract methods for metric alerts or keep a concrete no-op `evaluate`/provide default implementations in the base class.
